units.rawText: Gaah... The Oasis is so huge... I'm about to get hypoglycemia if I have to keep walking...

units.rawText: Oh, thanks... Hm? Professor... why are you here? Wait, don't tell me you're here to talk about our first encounter.

units.rawText: It was an emergency, and I changed my route to support the Oasis with only one message... I have nothing to talk about with you.
units.displayText: It was an emergency, and I changed my route to support the Oasis with only one message... I have nothing to talk about with you.

units.rawText: I was still in Rossum fighting Eucharist after all... Anyway, I remember; didn't we have a video meeting after that?

units.rawText: Errr... I really don't want to talk about that.

units.rawText: ...De Lacey was mistaken about you. Rather than someone who understands others, you're more of a mind reader... Can't you cut me some slack here? Or is this your way of trying to smooth things over between me and her?

units.rawText: Leave it. I have no intent to repair that bridge... But I don't hate her.
units.displayText: Leave it. I have no intent to repair that bridge... But I don't hate her.

spans.text: Leave it. I have no intent to repair that bridge... But I don't hate her.

units.rawText: I know she had to make that choice because of her position. What pisses me off is her wallowing in self-pity—it makes me not want to see her at all.

units.rawText: But I think Persicaria has changed since then.
units.displayText: But I think Persicaria has changed since then.

units.rawText: Yeah? Good for her, but that's none of my business.
units.displayText: Yeah? Good for her, but that's none of my business.

spans.text: Yeah? Good for her, but that's none of my business.

units.rawText: Gaah... that was too much serious talk... now I'm feeling sick. Professor, one more lollipop, please.

units.rawText: Well, fine. We've got plenty of time. Lind, how about we talk about your first day reporting in when you fainted from hypoglycemia right in front of me at HQ?

units.rawText: Bah, fine... With how insistent you are, and all those candies you've been giving me, I promise I'll talk to her sincerely when the day comes for us to really leave this place. For now, though, let's focus on the battles ahead.
